## My request:
시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 주제에 어울리는 랜덤한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: The requester asks independent random-concept tests of the just-discussed space-horror topic using the supplied image. I interpret the supplied portrait as facial/hair appearance guidance, with no claim about real identity, age or history. The coordinator scoped this arm to organic spacecraft and unfamiliar ecology; that is authorial scope, not a new requester lock. My independent random draw chose The Listening Nursery. I compared a broad panoramic nursery against a close landing and selected the latter because the human halted step and organisms leaning toward it can be visible together. The invented living hull, pool, sail organisms, listening implication, outfit, pose, moon, lamp and photographic arrangement are agent-owned staging, open to restrained refinements at creativity 1. Sensual 1 supports the warm unguarded human presence; fetish 0 and surreal 0 add no separate treatment. A viewer should first feel the intimacy of a person suddenly noticed by an unfamiliar habitat, then discover that the spacecraft itself is living. Visible geometry can suggest a response but cannot prove acoustic sensing or intention.
subject: A reference-appearance-guided woman exploring an organic spacecraft nursery; the human is the focal subject and all expedition-role details are agent-authored.
setting: The Listening Nursery: a maintenance landing inside a living spacecraft hull, beside a black pool of translucent sail organisms.
event: A space-horror encounter. Agent-authored staging has the explorer halt mid-step while near sail organisms bend toward her raised boot and distant organisms remain upright.
visual_priorities: Recognizable reference-guided face and dark bob within a warm, alert human presence.
Hull arches, vascular membranes and bolted porthole read as one living spacecraft structure.
Separate fan organisms retain visible fan, stalk and holdfast anatomy beside the landing.
The hovering boot, leaning near organisms, upright distant organisms and safe hand support remain readable together.
baseline_prompt_en: A photographic space-horror scene: a woman whose facial appearance and short dark bob are guided by the supplied portrait stands in an unsettling encounter inside the listening nursery of a living spacecraft. The supplied portrait guides her face and hair, while her work clothes and surroundings belong to this invented scene. Her large brown eyes, delicate oval face and wispy dark fringe remain recognizable in a clear three-quarter view. She wears a pale gray expedition coverall with a small amber work lamp at the sternum. Her lips are slightly parted as she looks down toward the nearest organism, her unguarded face warm and human against the chamber. She has stopped halfway through a careful step on a narrow maintenance landing. Her left boot is planted flat on the deck; her right boot hovers a few centimeters above it, knee softly bent. Her left hand grips the waist-high rail beside her, and her right hand stays close against her chest. The interrupted movement reads as a person suddenly realizing that this place can notice her. The inner hull forms broad pale cartilage arches joined by taut semitranslucent membranes with branching dark vessels. A manufactured circular porthole is set into one living arch, its bolted metal ring clasped by the membrane; through it, a sparse star field and the hard white edge of a distant moon establish the spacecraft's exterior. The deck and arch membranes meet in continuous grown folds, giving the structure the material continuity of an organ rather than decoration applied to a room. Beside the landing, a shallow black nursery pool supports a small colony of unfamiliar sail organisms. Each has a dark knotted holdfast fixed to the pool bed, a thin stalk and a broad translucent fan with fine radiating ribs. Three large near fans curve toward the woman's hovering boot, their wet edges close to the landing; two distant fans remain upright deeper in the pool. Tiny pale cilia form a fringe at the near holdfasts. These are separate organisms living within the vessel, distinct from the large structural hull arches. Her hovering boot, the nearest bending fans and their rooted bases are visible together across one diagonal gap. Compose a landscape 3:2 photograph from the landing at a slightly low three-quarter viewpoint. Her full figure fills the left foreground, the nearest colony fills the lower right, and the porthole stays readable above the pool. The amber lamp illuminates her face and catches the organisms' ribbed translucency; cold diffused blue from the porthole separates the hull membranes. Controlled shadows retain the stalks, holdfasts and rail grip. Detailed photographic skin, worn fabric, wet thin membranes and mineral residue give the impossible habitat convincing physical presence. The dominant feeling is the quiet instant before she dares lower her foot.
